requirement: 'I'm stuck' problem loop: Identify → Diagnose → Intervene → Execute → Measure
Rule-based diagnosis of stuck causes; unknown answers never forced into a cause
Habits use recovery/restart plans; no streak counters or shaming copy
Quick capture: free note/decision → rule-based extraction of amounts, percents, durations, dates, decisions → user confirms → reports use only confirmed items; original note stays on device
Field rules: one fact per field, taps over typing, short text ≤80 chars, every field shows what/why/example/format

Topic library: every owner topic (20 + Deen) has short practical tips with a visual; tips share tags so related tips appear across topics; all drafts marked unreviewed; sensitive topics carry safety notes
Reward picture: each finished task adds a star, each passed stage adds a garden layer; milestone moments; no points/ranks/streaks/comparison; text equivalent
Hideable side drawer listing all topics while the 5 phone tabs stay primary
